_meta.description: A small, hand-authored set of synthetic resume/job pairs used to sanity-check HireLens AI's scoring during development. This is NOT a large, externally validated benchmark -- it is intentionally small (8 pairs) and was constructed specifically for this project to cover a spread from clearly-strong to clearly-weak matches. Labels are the author's own judgment, not ground truth from real hiring outcomes. Treat results computed against this set as a smoke test for score direction and ordering, not a claim of real-world accuracy.
